hero.label: What We Do
hero.title: OUR SERVICES
hero.subtitle: A complete commercial toolkit for entering, growing and sustaining your business across Türkiye and Eurasia.

services.title: Market Entry
services.paragraph: Entering a new market without local knowledge is expensive and risky. We assess demand, map the competitive landscape, clarify regulatory requirements and build a practical entry plan tailored to your product and budget. From the first feasibility check to a registered presence, we keep your launch focused on what actually generates revenue.
steps: Initial feasibility assessment and market sizing
Regulatory and licensing requirements review
Entry strategy and channel selection
On-the-ground launch execution and follow-up

services.title: Local Representation
services.paragraph: When you cannot maintain a full-time presence in every market, we act as your local representative. We meet partners on your behalf, attend meetings and trade fairs, follow up on leads and protect your interests in day-to-day commercial discussions. You stay in control of strategy while we handle the local execution that requires being physically present.
steps: Define representation scope and authority
Identify key contacts and recurring touchpoints
Act on your behalf at meetings and events
Report back with clear outcomes and next steps

services.title: Distributor & Buyer Search
services.paragraph: Finding the right distributor or buyer is the difference between a market that performs and one that stalls. We tap into our regional network to shortlist candidates, vet their financial and operational standing, and arrange direct introductions. You receive qualified options, not a generic list, so your sales effort starts from a position of trust.
steps: Profile your ideal distributor or buyer
Shortlist and vet candidates from our network
Arrange and support initial introductions
Help structure the commercial relationship

services.title: B2B Matchmaking
services.paragraph: Good matchmaking is not about quantity, it is about fit. We curate targeted B2B meetings between your team and pre-screened partners, buyers and suppliers across the region. Every meeting has a clear objective, supporting context and a follow-up plan, so the time you invest turns into real commercial momentum.
steps: Clarify objectives and ideal partner profile
Curate and confirm relevant meeting counterparts
Host and facilitate focused B2B sessions
Track follow-ups until outcomes are secured

services.title: Market Research
services.paragraph: Strategy without data is guesswork. We deliver sector, competitor and pricing research grounded in primary sources and local fieldwork. Whether you are validating a new market or defending an existing position, our reports give you the facts and context needed to make confident commercial decisions.
steps: Define research questions and scope
Combine primary fieldwork with secondary data
Analyse competitors, pricing and demand
Deliver an actionable findings report

services.title: Business Development
services.paragraph: From the first contact to a signed commercial agreement, we stay alongside your team. We qualify leads, negotiate terms, resolve the small obstacles that slow deals down and help turn one-off transactions into long-term relationships. Our goal is sustained revenue growth, not a single handshake.
steps: Qualify inbound and outbound leads
Support negotiation and term sheets
Remove blockers slowing the deal down
Nurture the relationship after signing

cta.heading: Let's talk about your market entry
cta.paragraph: Tell us which service fits your current priority and we will shape a practical plan around it.
